checks: Cancelled metadata load never changes private slot, exposes an atlas, paints CSS/Core/base body, or commits later.
A superseded same-identity costume cannot overwrite the newer committed selection.
Two lazy costumes of the same UID stay isolated in both private slots and anatomical directions; decoded body art actually paints.
Shared concurrent loads fetch/register once; cancelling one consumer preserves the other live consumer.
Metadata SHA mismatch rejects before registration, asset fetch, or private slot mutation.
Cryptographically pinned JSON with a substituted identity still fails provenance validation.
PNG byte mismatch leaves staged metadata unpublished and forbids a costume/base flash.
Physical decode failure blocks commit despite correct SHA; an explicit retry can decode and then equip.
Metadata LRU drops only dormant lazy options and preserves both active identities plus every legacy native variant.
Mutable remote branch URLs and pending/unreviewed art cannot enter the library index.
scope: Production catalogs, registerBatch, renderer and library executed with synthetic pinned transport and decoded-image doubles. Cancellation/readiness/routing evidence; no physical PNG or canon visual attestation.
